source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
subject: a clearly adult 31-year-old perfume historian whose facial appearance is guided only by an adult facial-appearance reference
setting: a former embassy ballroom converted into a textile archive at a rain-muted 06:10 morning after a private exhibition
event: she is halfway through fastening an inventory tag to a leaking crystal perfume stopper while visibly continuing her work among event remnants
visual_priorities: former luxury and present deterioration must coexist on the same visible surfaces
post-event traces must connect directly to an awake adult's unfinished self-directed action
baseline_prompt_en: Create a non-explicit fashion editorial photograph in a former embassy ballroom converted into a textile archive at a rain-muted 06:10 morning after a private exhibition. A clearly adult 31-year-old perfume historian, with facial appearance guided only by an adult facial-appearance reference, stands alert and self-directed in a plum satin midi dress beneath a structured cream wool coat. She is halfway through fastening an inventory tag to a leaking crystal perfume stopper while her open ledger waits in her other hand, visibly continuing work among the remnants. Show former luxury through a ruby velvet settee, veined marble sampling table, flaking gold-leaf panels, satin drapery, and a crystal chandelier. On those same surfaces, make the velvet faded and threadbare, the marble edge cracked and dusty, the gold leaf tarnished and abraded, and the satin water-stained. Half-melted taper candles, toppled coupe glasses, wilted anemones, and scattered lot ribbons establish the event's aftermath. Frame a 28 mm cinematic environmental portrait from waist height, with rain-diffused dawn light and isolated tungsten pools revealing both sheen and decay. The scene stays awake, deliberate, and mid-action rather than posed rest.
